info.text:
Paid off your house? You still pay rent. To the county.
ATTOM: the average US single-family property tax bill was $4,427 in 2025, up from $3,785 in 2021.
Insurance.com put the average 2026 homeowners premium at $2,872 a year (for $300K dwelling coverage); a common upkeep rule of thumb is about 1% of value a year.
Example $400K home: $3,600 tax + $2,872 insurance + $4,000 upkeep = $10,472 a year, about $873 a month.
Unpaid property taxes can lead to tax foreclosure, as in Tyler v. Hennepin County (2023).
Sources: ATTOM 2025 property tax report; Insurance.com 2026; US Supreme Court, Tyler v. Hennepin County (2023).
News and education, not financial advice.
